title: AI Overviews on branded queries tripled in September
summary: Daily SERP tracking on branded keywords. AI Overview presence held near 27 percent for most of September 2026, then rose to 90.5 percent on 27 September and stayed above 80.
body_markdown:
[Chris Long shared some interesting observations on X](https://x.com/chris_nectiv/status/2105291766853173700) and[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7511040160994754560/) today and Barry Schwartz[noted that he had covered it as well](https://x.com/rustybrick/status/2105292291044757900) .


AI Overviews have more than tripled in the month of September for branded queries. We pulled data from our platform and confirmed that we’re seeing the same thing. You can see the sharp trend up for September. We’re working on pulling previous months as well.

## Method


Branded keywords tracked daily through[DemandMetrics](https://www.demandsphere.com/platform/demandmetrics/) , measured once per day per keyword, all markets, all devices. We’re working on breakdowns across devices and major markets. An AI Overview is counted as present when the SERP returns an AIO for the query, regardless of whether brand itself is cited in the AIO.


Confirmed ranking changes and algorithm updates are logged on the[Google Algorithm and AI Search Update Tracker](https://www.demandsphere.com/research/demandsphere-radar/algorithm-update-tracker/) . Google has not made any announcements on this change.
